name: Software Engineering
short_description: The overarching discipline of designing, building, and maintaining software systems.

name: Frontend Development
short_description: Building the user-facing part of web applications that runs in the browser.

name: Backend Development
short_description: Server-side application logic, APIs, and the systems that power clients.

name: Databases & Data Engineering
short_description: Storing, querying, moving, and analyzing data at rest and in motion.

name: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
short_description: Systems that learn from data: machine learning, deep learning, and modern AI.

name: Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure
short_description: Deploying, scaling, automating, and operating software in the cloud.

name: Cybersecurity
short_description: Protecting systems, data, and identities across every other domain.

name: Mobile & Desktop Development
short_description: Building native and cross-platform applications for phones and desktops.

name: Systems & Low-Level Engineering
short_description: Operating systems, embedded devices, and performance-critical low-level code.

name: Testing & Developer Tooling
short_description: Version control, testing, linting, and the tools that support engineering quality.

name: Game Development
short_description: Building interactive games: engines, gameplay, physics and XR, on top of the graphics stack.

name: Computer Networks
short_description: How computers communicate: protocols, routing, addressing, and the layered architecture of the internet.

name: Theoretical Computer Science
short_description: The mathematical foundations of computation: algorithms, complexity, automata, computability, logic, and formal methods.

name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems
short_description: Designing machines that sense, plan, and act in the physical world: kinematics, control, perception, SLAM, and motion planning.

name: Computer Architecture
short_description: The design of processors and memory systems: ISAs, pipelining, caches, and the hardware/software interface.

name: Embedded & Real-Time Systems
short_description: Software for dedicated hardware under real-time and resource constraints: firmware, RTOS, and microcontrollers.

name: Computer Graphics
short_description: Generating and manipulating images: rendering pipelines, ray tracing, shaders, and geometric modeling.

name: Quantum Computing & Information
short_description: Computing with qubits, superposition and entanglement to tackle problems that are hard for classical machines.

name: Blockchain & Web3
short_description: Shared ledgers secured by cryptography and consensus, and the applications built on them.

name: Internet of Things & Devices
short_description: Connected sensors and devices that measure, communicate and act on the physical world.

name: Computer Engineering
short_description: Where hardware meets software: processors, digital circuits, embedded devices and signals.

name: HCI & Interaction Design
short_description: How people perceive, use and are affected by computing systems, and how to design for them.

name: Interdisciplinary Computing
short_description: Computing applied to other fields: biology, finance, medicine, science, society and the arts.

name: Digital Design & VLSI
short_description: Designing digital circuits and chips, from logic gates to fabricated silicon.

name: Signal Processing
short_description: Analysing and transforming signals such as audio, images and radio, and the maths of communication.

name: Computational Biology
short_description: Algorithms and models for genomes, proteins and living systems.

name: FinTech & Computational Finance
short_description: Software for money: payments, trading, risk and financial regulation.

name: Health Informatics
short_description: Computing in healthcare: records, imaging, clinical decisions and medical devices.
